source_standard: GOV.UK Content Design / GDS style guide, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/content-design/writing-for-gov-uk

judgment_methodology.method: Nielsen Norman Group's 10 Usability Heuristics applied to microcopy/UX writing

planning_methodology.method: Content strategy quad (audience, purpose, message, structure) before drafting
planning_methodology.source: Halvorson, Content Strategy for the Web, 2nd ed (New Riders 2012)

deliverable_form.method: Voice-and-tone style guide entry with before/after example pairs

feedback_methodology.method: Plain-language review checklist (reading level, active voice, one idea per sentence)

review_methodology.method: Information-architecture cross-check: does the content's placement match its findability model
review_methodology.source: Rosenfeld, Morville & Arango, Information Architecture, 4th ed (O'Reilly 2015)

degree_level_knowledge.source: Halvorson, Content Strategy for the Web, 2nd ed (New Riders 2012)
Rosenfeld, Morville & Arango, Information Architecture, 4th ed (O'Reilly 2015)

reference_resolution.rule: content_id must resolve to an actual content page or document — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: plain_language_check is recomputed by re-running content against GDS plain-language conventions, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: new user-facing content is proposed on the branch AND no content-design record exists yet for that content_id

need_detector.condition: the target project has user-facing string literals in UI source (JSX/template text nodes matching a minimum length threshold, not single-word labels) AND no docs/**/content-design/style-guide.md exists anywhere in the repo tree
need_detector.false_positive_bound: a purely programmatic/API-only project with no rendered UI text never matches the string-literal heuristic, so it stays silent; the literal-length threshold is set deliberately conservative (favor false-silence over false-fire) and numeric tuning is phase-2 follow-up work, not decided numerically here

outcome_mission: the target project's user-facing copy is governed by an applied voice-and-tone standard a contributor can follow without re-deriving it — not a one-off review comment.

mission_deliverables.artifact: docs/issue-<n>/reports/content-design/style-guide.md (voice-and-tone entry + before/after example pairs, per the spec's existing deliverable_form field)
mission_deliverables.fit_criterion: every voice/tone rule carries at least one before/after pair drawn from real target-project copy, not a hypothetical example

mission_deliverables.artifact: microcopy patterns for the target project's actual UI moments (error message, empty state, button label) that exist in the current codebase
mission_deliverables.fit_criterion: each pattern names the UI moment and gives an answerable rule (exact wording or a template), checkable against the plain_language_check field already in required_fields

verified_by: requirements-engineering — content-design never grades its own mission_deliverables; plain-language/before-after verification is a documentation-quality check requirements-engineering already performs on records generally, and it never authors content-design's own deliverable
